faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Mezzofy and the Global Coupon Exchange Protocol

q1.question: What is Mezzofy?
q1.answer: Mezzofy is the Global Coupon Exchange Protocol — an AI-powered, tokenized infrastructure that connects coupon and voucher Supply directly to Demand. Founded in 2015 in Hong Kong, Mezzofy standardizes digital coupons into secure, fraud-proof assets, enabling merchants and distributors worldwide to create, exchange, and redeem coupons at scale.

q2.question: What is the Global Coupon Exchange Protocol?
q2.answer: The Global Coupon Exchange Protocol is Mezzofy's proprietary standard that transforms digital coupons into unique, tokenized digital assets. It provides a machine-readable clearinghouse for coupon creation, distribution, validation, and redemption — eliminating fraud, fragmentation, and high costs associated with traditional coupon platforms.

q3.question: Who founded Mezzofy and when?
q3.answer: Mezzofy was founded by Dicky in 2015 in Hong Kong. Dicky, a fintech entrepreneur specializing in digital coupons, NFC technology, and coupon exchange protocols, built Mezzofy to solve the fragmentation and security challenges in the global digital coupons industry.

q4.question: What industries and markets does Mezzofy serve?
q4.answer: Mezzofy serves multinational brands across retail, beauty, hospitality, finance, and entertainment sectors. The platform connects merchants and distributors in global markets, supporting coupon campaigns at scale for brands ranging from luxury retailers to fast-food chains and financial institutions.

q5.question: What awards has Mezzofy received?
q5.answer: Mezzofy has received recognition for innovation and sustainability, including the HK Awards for Environmental Excellence and dual ESG Forum 2024 awards. These honors reflect Mezzofy's commitment to reducing paper waste through digital coupon infrastructure and advancing environmental, social, and governance (ESG) standards.

q6.question: How does Mezzofy differ from traditional coupon software?
q6.answer: Unlike traditional coupon SaaS tools focused on features, Mezzofy is an Exchange Protocol built for network effects. Every coupon is tokenized into a unique, fraud-proof digital asset through the Mezzofy Coupon Standard — providing AI-native, machine-readable infrastructure as the standard interface for the next generation of autonomous AI commerce.

q7.question: How does Mezzofy support environmental sustainability?
q7.answer: Mezzofy advances sustainability by replacing paper coupons with digital, tokenized alternatives — reducing physical waste across retail and hospitality supply chains. This commitment earned Mezzofy the HK Awards for Environmental Excellence and ESG Forum 2024 recognition, demonstrating measurable environmental impact alongside commercial performance.

limits.title: Set your limits once. The network does the rest.
limits.description: Most platforms ask you to build a campaign and pay to run it. Zero Fee works the other way around.

zero.step1Desc: Discount range, minimum spend, monthly quota, daily cap, and whether offers are limited to off-peak hours. These are hard ceilings the AI cannot pass.
zero.step2Desc: It chooses the depth, the timing and the volume inside your limits, and issues each one as a tokenised Pass.
zero.step3Desc: Marketplace, NFC tap points in malls and offices, enterprise buyer apps, and AI shopping assistants. Nothing for you to build.
zero.step4Desc: Your staff validate in the Operator App, or through your POS if you have integrated. The Pass is spent and cannot be used again.
zero.note: What you give up is margin on that sale. Nothing else. No creation fee, no distribution fee, no redemption fee, no bank details. The customer pays a small fee for the guarantee that the offer is real, and that is what funds the exchange.

charge.step1Title: You set the value and the discount
charge.step1Desc: Choose the face value of the voucher, how much the customer saves, how long it stays valid, and how many you will release each month.
charge.step2Desc: Your voucher goes to the B2C marketplace and into the B2B pool where banks, telcos and benefits platforms draw from it. We handle payment and support.
charge.step3Title: The customer pays and receives the Pass
charge.step3Desc: It lands in their Vault, tokenised and single-use. Mezzofy keeps 10%, which covers card processing, the platform and any partner who distributed it.
charge.step4Title: You redeem, and we pay you
charge.step4Desc: You receive 90% of face value once the Pass is redeemed. If it is sold but expires unused, the remaining value is split evenly between you and Mezzofy.
charge.note: You are paid on redemption, not on sale. Money reaches you when the customer actually walks in. A bank account and full verification are required, because Mezzofy is paying you.

own.step1Desc: Build it yourself in the portal — value, terms, artwork, validity. Allocation is charged per Pass created, whether or not you send it.
own.step2Desc: Upload your own list or pick a segment. Nothing is listed on the exchange and no other buyer can see it.
own.step3Desc: Email, SMS, WhatsApp, QR export or your own app through the API. Distribution is charged per Pass sent. Messaging fees are passed through at cost.
own.step4Desc: Same Operator App and POS integration as every other Pass. Redemption is charged per Pass validated, and billed monthly to your card.
own.note: This is the one place you pay Mezzofy directly. Own channel is metered software for your own distribution, so allocation and distribution are charged whether or not anything is redeemed. Rates fall as your annual volume rises.

golive.outletsDesc: Add every location where your Passes can be redeemed. A Pass presented at an unregistered outlet will not validate. Enable and disable outlets individually at any time.
golive.redeemDesc: Free Operator App on iOS and Android — staff scan or key in the code. Or validate through your existing POS using our API, so nobody learns anything new.
golive.callout: Run a test redemption at each outlet before going live. A customer turned away with a valid Pass is the worst outcome for both of us. They paid for the guarantee that it would work.

faq.title: Questions merchants ask
faq.q1: Can the AI discount more than I can afford?
faq.a1: No. It cannot exceed the discount ceiling, the monthly quota or the daily cap you set. Those are enforced by the system, not guidelines.
faq.q2: What if I want to stop?
faq.a2: Pause from your dashboard and creation stops immediately. Passes already issued stay valid until they expire, because a customer has already paid for the guarantee that they work.
faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
faq.a3: Only if you sell Charge Passes, where we pay you. Zero Fee and own channel need no bank details.
faq.q4: Can I see what was created?
faq.a4: Every Pass, its limits, its status and its redemption history are in your dashboard in real time.
faq.q5: What if a Pass will not validate at my counter?
faq.a5: Check the outlet is registered and the Pass is inside its validity window. If it still fails, the customer is credited automatically and you are not charged. Nobody argues at the till.
faq.q6: How quickly am I paid on Charge Passes?
faq.a6: Redemptions settle on a fixed cycle to your registered bank account, with a statement per Pass. The cycle is stated in your agreement.

q1.question: Q: Do I need to download an app to use NFC coupons?
q1.answer: A: No! You can tap and view coupons directly in your mobile browser. However, downloading the Mezzofy Coupon Clipper app provides the best experience with automatic coupon collection and no personal data required.

q2.question: Q: What if my phone doesn't have NFC?
q2.answer: A: No problem! Every NFC coupon also has a QR code option. Simply open your camera app and scan the QR code to access the same coupon.

q3.question: Q: Does the Mezzofy Coupon Clipper app require personal information?
q3.answer: A: No! You can start using the app immediately without providing any personal data. It's designed for privacy and convenience.

q4.question: Q: Can I use a coupon multiple times?
q4.answer: A: It depends on the coupon terms. Most coupons are single-use, but some promotional offers allow multiple redemptions. Check the coupon details for specific information.

q5.question: Q: What happens if I tap a coupon but don't save it?
q5.answer: A: Without the app, you can still use the coupon immediately from the browser page. You can also save it to your device wallet (Apple, Google, or Samsung) or tap the same NFC sticker again later.

q6.question: Q: Can I transfer my coupons to someone else?
q6.answer: A: Yes! Through our C2C (Customer-to-Customer) portal, you can trade, gift, or sell unused coupons to other Mezzofy users.

q7.question: Q: What if the coupon doesn't work at checkout?
q7.answer: A: First, check that the coupon hasn't expired and that you're using it at a participating merchant. If issues persist, contact the merchant or Mezzofy customer support for assistance.

q8.question: Q: Which wallet should I use to save coupons?
q8.answer: A: We recommend the Mezzofy Coupon Clipper app for the best experience. However, you can also save to Apple Wallet (iPhone), Google Wallet (Android), or Samsung Wallet depending on your device.

hero.title: One primitive. Seven presentations.
hero.subtitle: A Pass is a tokenised entitlement with a unique code, issued once, held by one person, and consumed on validation. Whether it looks like a coupon, a ticket or a reward, the standard underneath is the same.

standard.title: The Mezzofy Pass Standard
standard.description: Three properties, enforced by the system rather than promised in terms.

unique.title: Unique
unique.desc: Every Pass carries its own serial, minted at issuance and traceable through its whole life. No two are alike, so a duplicate does not exist to be presented.

single.title: Single-use
single.desc: Validation consumes the Pass. It cannot be presented twice, screenshotted and reused, or forwarded after redemption. The exception is Card, which draws down instead.

fraud.title: Fraud-proof
fraud.desc: A Pass that was not issued by the exchange will not validate. Scraped codes, generated codes and expired offers are rejected at the counter, not discovered afterwards.

issued.d: By merchant, AI Coupon, or a loyalty programme

held.d: In a Vault, bound to one person

explorer.title: Seven presentations, and where each can go
explorer.description: Pick one to see it, how it is spent, whether it transfers, and where it can go. Transferability is a property of the Pass, not an assumption about the type.

coupon.name: Coupon
coupon.blurb: A discount off the bill. The commonest Pass on the exchange, and the one AI Coupon creates for merchants who list free.

voucher.name: Voucher
voucher.blurb: A prepaid value voucher sold on the marketplace and to enterprise buyers, paying the merchant on redemption.

deal.name: Deal
deal.blurb: A marketplace offer a consumer buys into, redeemed once at the counter.

ticket.name: Ticket
ticket.blurb: An admission or entry Pass. Often transferable, so it can be gifted before it is used.

reward.name: Reward
reward.blurb: A loyalty reward issued to members against points or status, honoured at participating merchants.

card.name: Card
card.blurb: A stored-value card. The exception to single-use — it draws down with each visit until the balance is gone.

token.name: Token
token.blurb: The raw tokenised entitlement, issued by API with rules set at issuance. The base every other presentation builds on.

dev.title: What a Pass looks like to a developer
dev.description: The same object whether it came from the marketplace, an enterprise draw, or a tap point.
